name: Carbon-Credit Fraud
description: Fraudulent creation, sale or claiming of carbon credits and emissions allowances, including double counting, non-existent projects, inflated baselines, VAT fraud on allowance trading and misleading offset claims. Fraud harms climate goals and investors.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market, Core Carbon Principles (2023)
Europol, public material on emissions trading fraud
IOSCO, Voluntary Carbon Markets: Final Report (2024)

exposure.rationale: Carbon credits and allowances traded via brokers and registries, sold to corporates and retail; credits are an asset outside the bank.

indicators.name: Project lacking verifiable registry entry or independent verification
indicators.canon: Project lacking verifiable registry entry or independent verification
indicators.desc: Credits sold from a project with no registry listing, uncertified verifier or conflicting documents.
indicators.ctx: Credits sold from a project with no registry listing, uncertified verifier or conflicting documents.
indicators.fp: New projects may still be in registration.

indicators.name: Same credits sold multiple times or retired and resold
indicators.canon: Same credits sold multiple times or retired and resold
indicators.desc: Serial numbers appear in more than one transaction or after retirement.
indicators.ctx: Serial numbers appear in more than one transaction or after retirement.
indicators.fp: Registry timing issues can show duplicate records.

indicators.name: Credits priced far below or above market with no quality basis
indicators.canon: Transaction price materially different from market value
indicators.desc: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
indicators.ctx: Offers significantly diverge from benchmark prices for the project type.
indicators.fp: Quality and vintage cause price variation.

indicators.name: Intermediary or broker with no track record and aggressive marketing
indicators.canon: Intermediary or broker with no track record and aggressive marketing
indicators.desc: New broker promises guaranteed returns or urgent allocation.
indicators.ctx: New broker promises guaranteed returns or urgent allocation.

indicators.name: Round-trip trading and VAT fraud in allowance markets
indicators.canon: Circular or round-trip flows among related parties
indicators.desc: Funds or goods-linked payments loop back to the originator or between related counterparties, or are traded back and forth.
indicators.ctx: Allowances bought and sold quickly among connected firms across borders with VAT unpaid.
indicators.fp: Active traders turn over positions fast.

indicators.name: Funds routed to project developers in high-risk jurisdictions with no activity
indicators.canon: Funds routed to project developers in high-risk jurisdictions with no activity
indicators.desc: Payments to developers in remote regions without site evidence.
indicators.ctx: Payments to developers in remote regions without site evidence.

indicators.name: Inflated baseline or additionality claims
indicators.desc: Reduction claims implausible versus public data or comparable projects.
indicators.ctx: Reduction claims implausible versus public data or comparable projects.

indicators.name: Retirement certificates claimed for corporate net-zero without registry proof
indicators.canon: Retirement certificates claimed for corporate net-zero without registry proof
indicators.desc: Companies or traders claim offsets via documents that do not match retirement records.
indicators.ctx: Companies or traders claim offsets via documents that do not match retirement records.
indicators.fp: Delays between retirement and posting occur.
